note: Native build inputs of the 26 routes for S05: upstream files at the pinned commit (archive identity where S01 acquired one) and the outputs regenerated from the pinned grammar by tsgk reproduce (tree-sitter 0.27.0, Node 24.21.0, ABI 15). The 6 adopted routes apply their literal patch chain in order first and every patched file must end at its adoption hash; the other 20 regenerate without patches (C2-REGENERATE-r1): an empty patch chain and no patched files. A route with a C2 record (C2-PATCH-r1, language-sources c2_patch) appends its subjects' file steps (src/dev/c2-patches/<route>.json /files/<i>, operations) to that chain, and its patched files are the C2 record's.
